home.hero_title: The flow of words from your personal bookshelf.
home.hero_desc: NovelHub is a lightweight, modern solution for managing and enjoying novels and ebooks — an alternative to Calibre. Keep your privacy fully intact with local storage, smart folder scanning, and a smooth reading experience right in your browser.
home.feature_manage_desc: Supports both Reference mode, which keeps original files intact, and Managed copy mode with automatic folder organization.
home.feature_reader_desc: An optimized reader that streams each chapter and image asset directly from ZIP/EPUB without eating up RAM.
home.feature_jobs_desc: Fast library scanning, automatic cover thumbnail generation, and background text extraction for full-text search (FTS).
home.footer: © {{year}} NovelHub. A lean local-first bookshelf platform.

webdav.title: WebDAV Server (RFC 4918)
webdav.subtitle: Connect Moon+ Reader, KyBook 3, FBReader, Marvin, Foliate, Zotero, or OS file explorers to browse and download books.
webdav.step1: Moon+ Reader / KyBook 3: Open Net Library -> Add WebDAV -> Paste the URL above.
webdav.step2: Authentication: Enter your NovelHub Email/Username and Password (or Magic Code).
webdav.step3: Browse your libraries as folders and download books directly to your device.

calibre.title: Calibre Content Server API
calibre.subtitle: Connect Calibre Companion, Aldiko, Moon+ Reader, or Calibre ecosystem apps to browse and download books.
calibre.guide_title: How to connect via Calibre Content Server:
calibre.step1: Calibre Companion (Android / E-Reader): In connection settings, select 'Calibre Content Server', and enter the Server URL above.
calibre.step2: Authentication: Use your NovelHub Email/Username and Password, or Bearer token.
calibre.step3: Calibre Desktop: Use 'Connect/share' -> 'Connect to folder' pointing to the WebDAV mount, or use the 'calibredb' CLI.

koreader.title: KOReader 2-Way Progress Sync (Kosync)
koreader.subtitle: Real-time two-way reading progress synchronization between KOReader devices and NovelHub.
koreader.step1: Open top menu in KOReader -> Go to Settings (gear icon) -> Select 'Progress sync' (Kosync).
koreader.step2: Enable 'Progress sync' -> Tap 'Custom server' -> Enter the Sync Server URL above.
koreader.step3: Register or log in using your NovelHub account email and password.
